import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Conjecture 5.26

by H. Koch

Let $G$ be a finite $p$-group with the minimal number of generators $d$, and let $r_1$
(respectively, $r_2$) be the minimal number of defining relations on $d$ generators in the
sense of representing $G$ as a factor-group of a free discrete group (pro-$p$-group). It is
well known that always $r_2 > d^2/4$. For each prime number $p$ denote by $c(p)$ the exact
upper bound for the numbers $b(p)$ with the property that $r_2 \geq b(p)d^2$ for all finite
$p$-groups.

a) It is obvious that $r_1 \geq r_2$. Find a $p$-group with $r_1 > r_2$.

b) *Conjecture:* $\lim_{p \to \infty} c(p) = 1/4$. It is proved (J. Wisliceny,
*Math. Nachr.*, **102** (1981), 57–78) that $\lim_{d \to \infty} r_2 / d^2 = 1/4$.

## Formalisation notes

* $d = d(G)$ is `Group.rank G`, the minimal size of a generating set of $G$.
* $r_1(G)$ is `discreteRelationRank G`: the minimum, over all surjections
  $\varphi \colon F_d \to G$ from the free (discrete) group on $d$ generators, of the minimal
  number of normal generators of $\ker \varphi$.
* $r_2(G)$ is `proPRelationRank p G`: the minimal number of relators of a pro-$p$ presentation
  of $G$ on $d$ generators. Mathlib has no free pro-$p$ groups, so this is formalised through
  the standard identity $r_2(G) = \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} H^2(G, \mathbb{F}_p)$ for the relation
  rank of a minimal pro-$p$ presentation of a finite $p$-group (see e.g. Koch, *Galois theory
  of $p$-extensions*, §4, or Neukirch–Schmidt–Wingberg, *Cohomology of number fields*,
  Cor. 3.9.5).
* $c(p)$ is `c p`: the supremum of the set of $b \in \mathbb{R}$ with $r_2(G) \geq b \, d(G)^2$
  for every finite $p$-group $G$. This set contains $0$ and is bounded above by $1$ (take
  $G = \mathbb{Z}/p$), so the supremum is a genuine one.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

open Filter Topology

namespace Kourovka.«5.26»

/--
The minimal number $r_1(G)$ of defining relations of a finite group $G$ on $d = d(G)$
generators, where $G$ is represented as a factor-group of the free (discrete) group $F_d$ on
$d$ generators. That is, the minimum over all surjective homomorphisms
$\varphi \colon F_d \to G$ and all finite sets $S \subseteq F_d$ whose normal closure is
$\ker \varphi$ of the cardinality of $S$.
-/
noncomputable def discreteRelationRank (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] : ℕ :=
  sInf {r : ℕ | ∃ (φ : FreeGroup (Fin (Group.rank G)) →* G)
    (S : Finset (FreeGroup (Fin (Group.rank G)))),
    Function.Surjective φ ∧ S.card = r ∧ Subgroup.normalClosure (S : Set _) = φ.ker}

/--
The minimal number $r_2(G)$ of defining relations of a finite $p$-group $G$ on $d = d(G)$
generators, where $G$ is represented as a factor-group of the free pro-$p$ group on $d$
generators. For a finite $p$-group this relation rank equals
$\dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} H^2(G, \mathbb{F}_p)$, which is how it is defined here.
-/
noncomputable def proPRelationRank (p : ℕ) (G : Type) [Group G] : ℕ :=
  Module.finrank (ZMod p) (groupCohomology.H2 (Rep.trivial (ZMod p) G (ZMod p)))

/-- The trivial group has no relations. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem discreteRelationRank_of_subsingleton (G : Type*) [Group G] [Subsingleton G] :
    discreteRelationRank G = 0 := by
  have hrank : Group.rank G = 0 := by
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
    simpa using Group.rank_le (G := G) (S := ∅) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have : IsEmpty (Fin (Group.rank G)) := by rw [hrank]; infer_instance
  refine Nat.sInf_eq_zero.2 (Or.inl ⟨1, ∅, fun g => ⟨1, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, rfl, ?_⟩)
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- The trivial group has no relations. -/
@[category test, AMS 20]
theorem proPRelationRank_of_subsingleton (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type) [Group G]
    [Subsingleton G] : proPRelationRank p G = 0 := by
  have := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.1
    (isZero_groupCohomology_succ_of_subsingleton (Rep.trivial (ZMod p) G (ZMod p)) 1)
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

/--
For a prime $p$, $c(p)$ is the exact upper bound (supremum) of the numbers $b$ such that
$r_2(G) \geq b \, d(G)^2$ for all finite $p$-groups $G$.
-/
noncomputable def c (p : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  sSup {b : ℝ | ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Finite G], IsPGroup p G →
    (proPRelationRank p G : ℝ) ≥ b * (Group.rank G : ℝ) ^ 2}

/--
It is obvious that $r_1 \geq r_2$. Find a $p$-group with $r_1 > r_2$.

Formalised as the existence of a prime $p$ and a finite $p$-group $G$ with
$r_1(G) > r_2(G)$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«5.26».parts.a :
    ∃ (p : ℕ) (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : Finite G),
      p.Prime ∧ IsPGroup p G ∧ proPRelationRank p G < discreteRelationRank G := by
  sorry

/--
*Conjecture:* $\lim_{p \to \infty} c(p) = 1/4$, where $c(p)$ is the exact upper bound of the
numbers $b$ such that $r_2 \geq b \, d^2$ for all finite $p$-groups, and the limit is taken
over prime numbers $p$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«5.26».parts.b :
    Tendsto c (atTop ⊓ 𝓟 {p : ℕ | p.Prime}) (𝓝 (1 / 4)) := by
  sorry

end Kourovka.«5.26»

by H. Koch

For a finite $p$-group $G$, compare the minimum numbers of relations in a presentation on a
minimal generating set when the presenting group is free discrete or free pro-$p$. Also determine
the asymptotic best universal lower bound for the pro-$p$ relation rank.

*Reference:* [The Kourovka Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.0300v46)
-/

namespace Kourovka.«5.26»

/-- The minimum cardinality of a finite generating tuple of a group. -/
noncomputable def generatorRank (G : Type*) [Group G] : ℕ :=
  sInf {n : ℕ | ∃ x : Fin n → G, Subgroup.closure (Set.range x) = ⊤}

/-- The minimum number of defining relations among presentations of `G` by the free discrete
group on `generatorRank G` generators. A tuple defines the kernel when its normal closure is the
kernel. -/
noncomputable def discreteRelationRank (G : Type*) [Group G] : ℕ :=
  sInf {n : ℕ | ∃ φ : FreeGroup (Fin (generatorRank G)) →* G,
    Function.Surjective φ ∧ ∃ r : Fin n → FreeGroup (Fin (generatorRank G)),
      Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range r) = φ.ker}

/-- For a prime `p`, the relation rank of a finite $p$-group in the pro-$p$ sense, expressed by
the equivalent formula $\dim_{\mathbb F_p} H^2(G, \mathbb F_p)$ with trivial coefficients. -/
noncomputable def proPRelationRank (p : Nat.Primes) (G : Type) [Group G] : ℕ :=
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime (p : ℕ)) := ⟨p.property⟩
  Module.finrank (ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (groupCohomology (Rep.trivial (ZMod (p : ℕ)) G (ZMod (p : ℕ))) 2)

/-- For a prime $p$, the exact upper bound of the real numbers $b$ such that every finite
$p$-group $G$ satisfies $r_2(G) \geq b d(G)^2$. -/
noncomputable def c (p : Nat.Primes) : ℝ :=
  sSup {b : ℝ | ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] [Finite G], IsPGroup (p : ℕ) G →
    (proPRelationRank p G : ℝ) ≥ b * (generatorRank G : ℝ) ^ 2}

/--
Find a finite $p$-group for which the minimum number $r_1$ of relations in a discrete
presentation on the minimal number of generators is strictly greater than the corresponding
minimum number $r_2$ in a pro-$p$ presentation.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 20]
theorem kourovka.«5.26».parts.a :
    ∃ (p : Nat.Primes) (G : Type) (_ : Group G) (_ : Finite G),
      IsPGroup (p : ℕ) G ∧ discreteRelationRank G > proPRelationRank p G := by
  sorry

/--
For each prime $p$, let $c(p)$ be the supremum of the real numbers $b$ such that
$r_2(G) \geq b d(G)^2$ for every finite $p$-group $G$. The conjecture is
$\lim_{p \to \infty} c(p) = 1/4$, where the limit is taken along the primes.
-/

theorem kourovka.«5.26».parts.b :
    Filter.Tendsto c
      (Filter.comap ((↑) : Nat.Primes → ℕ) Filter.atTop)
      (nhds (1 / 4 : ℝ)) := by
  sorry

    ext xy
    simp
    abel

    ext xy
    simp
    ring

$\mathbb F_p$. Its kernel is the space of degree-two cocycles. -/

    (G × G → ZMod p) →ₗ[ZMod p] (G × G × G → ZMod p) where
  toFun f xyz := f (xyz.2.1, xyz.2.2) - f (xyz.1 * xyz.2.1, xyz.2.2) +
